title: StickS3 校园天气机 v1.0.0 虚拟设备功能验证

execution.environment: Local Device Service /api/v1; StickS3 QEMU and esp-emu; PlatformIO Core 6.2.0; Arduino-ESP32 2.0.17; M5GFX 0.2.32

checks.name: littlefs_voice_assets
checks.detail: 68608-byte non-silent PCM, 2.144 seconds at 16 kHz mono

checks.name: wifi_association_http
checks.detail: ArduinoOTA initialized after WiFiConnect; QEMU data path reached Open-Meteo-backed UI

checks.name: live_weather_ui
checks.detail: Shenzhen 31 C, humidity 40-41%, wind 14.2 m/s, AQI 104-105

checks.name: full_visual_layout
checks.detail: eight complete pages without tiling or repeated lower-half fragments

checks.name: key2_double_click
checks.detail: third-party app clears pending state at 350 ms before M5Unified's 500 ms double-click decision

checks.name: post_reconfigure_warm_restart
checks.detail: cold boot of retained flash entered portal; first warm-restart run did not complete in the test window

checks.name: portal_webpage_http
checks.detail: guest-local AP has no Device Service host route

checks.name: power_save_wake
checks.detail: framebuffer states examined; panel brightness is not exposed

checks.name: source_release_alignment
checks.evidence: v1.0.0 tag differs from HEAD only by tools/make_release.ps1

checks.name: firmware_static_analysis
checks.evidence: ESP32-S3, 8 MiB flash, valid partition table, app0, 207-entry LittleFS

checks.name: qemu_boot_original_image
checks.evidence: M5StickS3 detected and setup frame rendered; NVS/LittleFS reads failed

checks.name: nvs_persistence_esp_emu
checks.evidence: seed read back before and after M5 init

checks.name: wifi_association_and_ota_esp_emu
checks.evidence: WiFiConnect returned to setupOta; ArduinoOTA started

checks.name: key1_eight_page_cycle
checks.evidence: eight distinct frame hashes and labels

checks.name: audio_and_speech
checks.evidence: LittleFS not mounted in the validated run

notes: No host weather values were injected into the device UI.
No physical hardware, RF, power or electrical measurements are claimed.
Original published firmware hash is unchanged.
Virtual display defects are not attributed to the user firmware without hardware comparison.
Follow-up fixed the QIO read shift; remaining failures are isolated to application double-click timing, warm restart coverage and guest-local portal routing.
